breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: Hepatopulmonary syndrome (HPS) is a lung disease characterized by widening of arteries and veins (dilatation) in the lungs in people who have chronic liver disease. Because of the dilated vases, the workload of the heart increases and the blood pumped to the body does not have enough oxygen, leading to a decreased level of oxygen in the blood (hypoxemia). The normal diameter of the lung vessels ranges between 8 and 15 μm whereas when in HPS rises to between 15 and 500 μm. While many people with HPS don't have any obvious problems, the main reported symptom is shortness of breath (dyspnea) that is worse when standing or sitting up, and is relieved when lying down (platypnea). Symptoms related to chronic liver disease (generally cirrhosis) include small red spots on the skin (spider angiomas) and abnormal vascular dilatations. Some other symptoms that have been described are infections in the brain (brain abscesses), brain bleeding and an increased number of red blood cells in the blood (polycythemia). There is currently no effective medication for HPS. Oxygen therapy may improve the breathing in some cases. Liver transplant is an efficient treatment which improves the symptoms, even in severe cases.

master.definition_en: An invasive adenocarcinoma composed of malignant glandular cells which contain intracytoplasmic mucin. Often, the infiltrating glandular structures are associated with mucoid stromal formation. It may arise from the large and small intestine, appendix, stomach, lung, ovary, breast, corpus uteri, cervix, vagina, and salivary gland.

master.definition_en: Circumscribed collections of suppurative material occurring in the spinal or intracranial epidural space. The majority of epidural abscesses occur in the spinal canal and are associated with osteomyelitis of a vertebral body; analgesia, epidural; and other conditions. Clinical manifestations include local and radicular pain, weakness, sensory loss, urinary incontinence, and fecal incontinence. Cranial epidural abscesses are usually associated with osteomyelitis of a cranial bone, sinusitis, or otitis media. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p710 and pp1240-1; J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry 1998 Aug;65(2):209-12)

master.definition_en: Macrocephaly-intellectual disability-left ventricular non compaction syndrome is a rare, genetic, syndromic intellectual disability characterized by motor and cognitive developmental delay with language impairment, macrocephaly, hypotonia, dysmorphic facial features (including long face, slanting palpebral fissures and prominent, flattened nose) and left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy. Patients also present skeletal abnormalities (e.g. scoliosis, finger clinodactyly, pes planus), slender build and shy behavior. Strabismus and various neurological signs (including ataxia, tremor and hyperreflexia) may be associated, as well as epilepsy, autism and MRI findings showing a small cerebellum and abnormalities of the corpus callosum. A phenotypic variant with no cardiac involvement has been reported.

master.definition_en: Autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2K (LGMD2K) is a form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy characterized by the onset of slowly progressive proximal muscle weakness during childhood (with fatigue and difficulty running and climbing stairs) and developmental delay. Mild intellectual deficit and microcephaly, without any obvious structural brain abnormality, are found in all patients. Mild pseudohypertrophy and joint contractures of the ankles have also been reported.

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

master.definition_en: A rare congenital abnormality of the heart characterized by the presence of three atria. The right or left atrium is divided into two parts by fibromuscular tissue or a membrane. It may be associated with other heart congenital abnormalities.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”

master.definition_en: A carcinoma that arises from the intrahepatic biliary tree (intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma) or from the junction, or adjacent to the junction, of the right and left hepatic ducts (hilar cholangiocarcinoma). Grossly, the malignant lesions are solid, nodular, and grayish. Morphologically, the vast majority of cases are adenocarcinomas. Signs and symptoms include malaise, weight loss, right upper quadrant abdominal pain, and night sweats. Early detection is difficult and the prognosis is generally poor.

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 肝胆胰高凶险实体瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 起病隐匿但恶性度极高、侵袭转移快，患者常以无痛性进行性黄疸或肝内占位首诊，多数确诊已属不可切除晚期，未治中位生存期仅3–6个月；胆道完全梗阻并发急性化脓性胆管炎(AOSC)时可在数小时至数日内因感染性休克及肝衰竭致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期可根治性R0手术切除（约占20%–30%患者）联合术后辅助卡培他滨是唯一治愈途径，术后5年生存率约25%–40%；晚期整体5年生存率仅约3%–10%，但近年“化疗+PD-1/PD-L1免疫”及针对FGFR2融合、IDH1突变、HER2扩增、BRAF V600E的精准靶向已将部分患者中位生存延长至1年以上。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN通常将肝内胆管癌(iCCA，约占原发性肝癌的10%–15%)归入肝癌大类，肝外胆管癌归入胆道/胆囊大类；全球肝内胆管癌死亡率近年呈持续上升趋势，东南亚（尤其泰北肝吸虫流行区）发病率最高

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列全国胆管癌死亡统计；国内iCCA约占原发性肝癌的10%–15%（推算年死亡约3万–4.5万例），华南肝吸虫（华支睾吸虫）及肝胆管结石高发区负担尤重
annual_deaths_china.source: 《原发性肝癌诊疗指南》 / CSCO胆道恶性肿瘤诊疗指南

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 胆道梗阻并发急性梗阻性化脓性胆管炎(Charcot三联征/Reynolds五联征：高热寒战、黄疸、腹痛、休克、意识障碍)：立即静脉广谱抗感染+抗休克补液，24小时内急诊行ERCP内镜胆道支架置入或PTCD经皮经肝胆道引流减压; 2) 胆道出血或肿瘤破裂出血：立即禁食止血、输血并急诊介入动脉栓塞(TAE)。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 2026年胆管癌精准靶向迎来密集获批：FDA于2026年5月批准HER2/HER3双抗Zenocutuzumab用于NRG1融合胆管癌，2026年9月批准高选择性FGFR2不可逆抑制剂Lirafugratinib；中国NMPA于2026年附条件批准国产FGFR2抑制剂Fanregratinib；2) HER2阳性胆管癌靶向药物Zanidatamab(HER2双抗)与德曲妥珠单抗(T-DXd)显著提升后线ORR至40%以上；3) TOPAZ-1与KEYNOTE-966确立免疫联合GC化疗一线基石地位；4) 胆汁ctDNA液体活检结合AI影像组学正显著提升极难活检的肝门部胆管癌早期诊断率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 约70%患者确诊时已丧失手术根治机会，早期无创诊断标志物极度缺乏; 2) FGFR2多克隆耐药突变及缺乏可靶向基因突变(约占50%–60%)的患者生存仍很有限; 3) 丰富致密纤维间质微环境严重阻碍药物与免疫细胞浸润。

master.name_en: multiple congenital anomalies due to 14q32.2 imprinting defect
master.definition_en: Multiple congenital anomalies caused by imprinting defects at 14q32.2 include Kagami-Ogata syndrome and Temple syndrome. Kagami-Ogata syndrome is characterized by typical facial features, skeletal abnormalities (including "coat-hanger ribs", and bell-shaped thorax), abdominal wall defects, and developmental delay, and is caused by defects or absence of maternally derived imprinting signals (including paternal UPD14). Temple syndrome is a less specific phenotype including intrauterine and postnatal growth restriction, hypotonia, feeding difficulties in infancy, truncal obesity, and small feet and hands. Temple syndrome is caused by defects or absence of paternally derived imprinting signals (including maternal UPD14).

master.name_zh: 急性有机磷农药及常见急性中毒
master.definition_en: A poisoning that is caused by exposure to organophosphate.

curated.name_zh: 急性有机磷农药及常见急性中毒
curated.name_en: Acute Organophosphate and Common Acute Poisoning
curated.category: 急诊中毒与理化因素疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 高脂溶性毒物经消化道、皮肤或呼吸道迅速抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶，引发乙酰胆碱剧烈蓄积，可在数分钟至数小时内因支气管痉挛大汗肺水肿（窒息）、呼吸肌麻痹及中枢呼吸中枢衰竭致命；数日后仍可因“中间综合征”致延迟呼吸肌麻痹猝死，合并常见急性中毒（如百草枯、鼠药、镇静催眠药或一氧化碳）亦可急性致命。中国住院AOPP病死率据区域和毒物剧毒程度差异跨度达3%-40%。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 急性有机磷中毒具备黄金特效解毒剂组合（抗胆碱药阿托品/戊乙奎醚 + 胆碱酯酶复能剂氯解磷定），只要抢在胆碱酯酶“老化”前早期足量洗消解毒、尽早机械通气与血液灌流清除血中游离毒物，绝大多数患者可完全获救治愈。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO在SDG 3.9.3统计2019年全球意外中毒死亡约19.3万例（标化约0.7/10万），Mew等系统综述估算2006-2015年全球农药自服年致死11万-16.8万例，WHO另估计全球有机磷农药中毒（AOPP）年死亡约20万例；因“意外”、“自服”、“农药/全部中毒”交叉口径不一，按范围详述而不混同单一数值

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无全国全毒物单列精确年度总死因；流行病学文献显示有机磷农药中毒（AOPP）长期占我国急性中毒住院病例的20%-50%，病死率因地区急救条件及高剧毒老品种差异在3%-40%不等（随剧毒高毒有机磷禁限用已呈显著下行）

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球每年估计发生约300万例重度急性有机磷中毒及其他高危化学毒物中毒，农村及农业发展中地区为绝对重灾区（高毒农药易得）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 我国基层及农村急诊中毒以急性有机磷/拟除虫菊酯农药、一氧化碳（冬季煤炭取暖）、野生毒蕈及药物（镇静安眠药、抗抑郁药）过量最为高发；近年来随着高毒有机磷逐步退市，城市居民药物、美容化学品及新型混合中毒比重上升。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 急性有机磷中毒抢救“四早一彻底”原则：1) 迅速脱离现场、脱去污染衣物用肥皂水（敌百虫改用清水禁碱）彻底清洗皮肤毛发；口服者争分夺秒在保障气道安全前提下温清水彻底反复洗胃（防毒物残留反跳）+活性炭吸附；2) 立即双通路静脉联合使用特效解毒剂：早期大剂量反复静脉注射阿托品迅速达“阿托品化”（肺部湿啰音消失、心率适度、瞳孔不再缩小），或长效高选择M受体拮抗剂盐酸戊乙奎醚（长托宁）；同步尽早足量肌注/静脉氯解磷定（PAM-Cl）或解磷定复活被抑制的胆碱酯酶；3) 一旦呼吸肌无力/血氧跌落立即气管插管呼吸机支持，高龄重度患者备长程预防“中间综合征”；4) 脂溶性高/大剂量口服者即刻行血液灌流（HP）联合血液滤过快速清除游离毒物；其他常见中毒如CO中毒即刻高压氧、对乙酰氨基酚予NAC、阿片类予纳洛酮、苯二氮䓬予氟马西尼。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 生物酶“血液内清除（Bioscavenger）”前沿转化：重组丁酰胆碱酯酶（rBChE）及工程化磷酸三酯酶纳米递送系统可在血液循环中直接催化水解高毒有机磷分子而不依赖传统肟类复能剂耐老化限制，已推进至早期临床/大动物军民毒物防护评估；2) 针对百草枯/敌草快等至今无特效解毒剂的急性高致死中毒，国内急诊学界深入探索新型靶向肺纤维化抑制剂（吡非尼酮/尼达尼布）及早期联合血液灌流+血浆置换标准化“泰山/齐鲁共识”路径，力争压降极高病死率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 氯解磷定及现有肟类对敌百虫、久效磷及部分新型快速老化型有机磷“酶老化”后彻底无效，亟待广谱可重活化新型肟类或生物清道夫酶上市；2) 新兴隐蔽性剧毒农药（如敌草快替代百草枯后中毒率激增）、未知复合网购减肥药/有毒野生菌缺乏床旁15分钟快速质谱毒物谱筛查；3) 基层医院常备冷僻解毒剂储备短缺问题依然存在。

master.definition_en: A rare intestinal disease characterized by a single, focal intestinal perforation, associated with hemorrhagic necrosis, typically occurring at the terminal ileum, involving antimesenteric border. It may also occur in the jejunum or colon. It predominantly affects very (or extremely) low weight infants (birth weight less than 1500 g) mostly in the first week of life. Patients have healthy bowel apart from the perforation site, they present with bluish discoloration and gasless abdomen in the absence of pneumatosis intestinalis. Urinary tract infection can also be present. However they do not manifest necrotizing enterocolitis, bowel obstruction or prodromal clinical symptoms.

master.definition_en: A rare central nervous system embryonal tumor characterized by embryonal cells arranged in multilayered rosettes and displaying one of three morphological patterns: embryonal tumor with abundant neuropil and true rosettes, ependymoblastoma, or medulloepithelioma. The tumors typically have a C19MC alteration or (rarely) a DICER1 mutation and correspond to WHO grade IV. They are mostly localized intracranially, rarely in the spinal cord, and commonly cause signs and symptoms of elevated intracranial pressure, sometimes seizures and focal neurological signs. Most cases occur in children during the first two years of life.
